q1.sampleAnswer:
Hello Mr Lyons,
I think it’s great idea to perform students plays in the school theatre. I heard, you need help with the scenery of the stage, and I would like to offer my help with it. if you want a lot of people as the audience, we can make some posters, record something like the trailer and make an article on the school website.
I’m really sorry, but I can’t meet next Tuesday after school, because I have got volleyball trainin, could we meet next Friday after school?
Mikhail

keyPoints.descZh: 内容：回应邮件中的四条笔记：①表示学生演英语话剧是个好主意（Great idea!）；②主动提出自己能帮什么忙，如表演、画布景或做服装（Offer …）；③告诉 Lyons 老师怎样让学生和家长知道这场演出（Tell Mr Lyons）；④抱歉地说明下周二放学后不能参加会议，并说明原因（Sorry, but …）
交际效果：文体和语气符合任务要求，能清楚表达观点并吸引读者
条理性：结构清晰、衔接连贯，使用多种连接词和衔接手段
语言：词汇和语法结构的丰富性与准确性

anchors.noteZh: 内容5/交际效果4/条理性4/语言4。四个要点都已回应；用中立、礼貌的语气给老师写信（Hello Mr Lyons, I would like to offer, I’m really sorry, could we meet），信息较简单但也有细节（make some posters, record something like the trailer）；顺序与题目一致，用 and, if…we can, but, because 等基础连接词；能用 I would like to, could we meet 等结构，但重复题目原词较多（great idea, scenery of the stage），有 it’s great idea, trainin 等小错误，不影响理解。

anchors.response:
Dear Mr Lyons,
I think school play is a perfect idea! I’ve been always dreaming about acting. I’m so thankful for this e-mail! Can I help you with costumes? – I did a lot of costumes when I was younger. I can also participate in school play as an actor. I will ask my friend about scenery – she is good at art. I will inform my family about the play and I will ask them about going to this play. We can also invite other kids from another classes. I have a great idea about school blog – we can make a drama club and then make blog about it!
Unfortunately I can’t go with you to a meeting next Tuesday, because I have an important meeting from art club and then two extra classes from English and Math. So shall we bring this meeting to Friday? I will be very pleased.
Olena
anchors.noteZh: 内容5/交际效果5/条理性5/语言5。四个要点都充分回应；语气礼貌，适合写给老师（Dear Mr Lyons, I’m so thankful for this e-mail, shall we bring this meeting to Friday?），能吸引读者；分段清楚，用 and, also, then, because, So 和代词指代衔接，只是开头句稍短；词汇恰当（participate, invite, blog），时态和问句多样，只有 I think school play 等极少错误。

q1.explanationZh: 满分邮件要逐一回应四条笔记：赞同演话剧、提出自己能帮的忙、建议宣传演出的办法、礼貌说明下周二不能开会及原因（可提出改时间）；语气礼貌，分段清楚，约 100 词。

q3.sampleAnswer: Toby was getting ready to go on fantastic day out. It was Wednesday. The weather was very sunny. Toby went to school at 7:30 AM. Today his class travelled for a school trip. He wasn’t very excited. The trip was to the mountains. Toby didn’t want to go there, but his teacher told that, everyone has to go on trip. When they finally arrived, after 5 hours, they went to mountains. Toby was very tired of travelling, and now he had to walk up. When he was walking he saw a men. It was his favourite, famous actor! Toby talked with him and took photo. All of his energy went back to him, and he very enjoyed this school trip.

keyPoints.descZh: 内容：故事以给定的句子开头（Toby 正准备去度过精彩的一天），情节与开头句相关、合乎逻辑，有清楚的开头、发展和结尾
交际效果：文体和语气符合任务要求，能清楚表达观点并吸引读者
条理性：结构清晰、衔接连贯，使用多种连接词和衔接手段
语言：词汇和语法结构的丰富性与准确性

anchors.noteZh: 内容5/交际效果3/条理性3/语言3。故事承接开头句展开，有开头、中间和结尾，事件顺序清楚，也写出了主人公的感受（He wasn’t very excited）；用 but, When they finally arrived 等衔接，但很多句子过短（It was Wednesday. The weather was very sunny.），影响连贯；词汇基本恰当，句型简单，有 go on fantastic day out, his teacher told that, he very enjoyed 等错误，不影响理解。

anchors.response: Toby was getting ready to go on a fantastic day out. He was preparing for going shopping with his parents. They wanted to go to a space shop and buy some things they’ll need on their holidays on Mars. Toby was very young and he had never been on other planets. His older sister was on Mars only once but she enjoyed her travel very much. She told him that on some parts of this planet the weather is very cold and on some parts warm. Because of that he had to buy new clothes. Toby and his family wanted to buy the smartclothes. They are warm when the weather is cold and cold if the weather is hot. When the family was ready to go out they heard in the radio that there will be a metorid rain. Because of that they couldn’t go. Toby was very sad but his mum said that they will go to the shop next week.
anchors.noteZh: 内容5/交际效果4/条理性4/语言4。故事承接开头句富有想象力地展开（去太空商店为火星度假购物），开头、中间、结尾清楚，用描述和解释吸引读者；用 and, but, Because of that, When 等衔接，想法之间联系清楚；能用多种过去时和将来时，但 shop, travel, weather 等词重复，有 heard in the radio, metorid rain 等小错误。

q3.explanationZh: 满分故事要用给定句开头，交代 Toby 要去哪里、发生了什么、结果如何，情节连贯有结尾，叙事时态准确，词汇丰富，约 100 词。
